hero.eyebrow: Habbo room builder · Open for commissions
hero.lead: Builds, event halls, mazes, RP maps, you name the vibe. Custom Habbo rooms with working wired mechanics, delivered on time and built to be walked around in.

pricing.heading: Pick your build
pricing.subtext: Each tier shows the room size it covers, so you can see exactly what you're getting.

tiers.name: BASIC
features: One small–medium room / Themed and decorated / 1 round of tweaks / Turnaround around 2-3 days

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: Send theme, room size, references and deadline via the form or Discord.

steps.title: Quote
steps.text: I confirm scope, price and timeline. A 50% deposit locks your slot.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: I build it and send a preview. Your revisions happen right here.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: Final payment, then the room is handed over and it's yours.

commission.heading: Ready to commission a room?
commission.subtext: Fill in the request form below with your brief, or reach out directly. I usually reply within 24 hours.
